dm_strategic_behaviour.definition: Acting in a planned way to produce a result, rather than acting in the way that comes naturally.
dm_strategic_behaviour.example: Strategic behaviour won him the interview; it did not make him better at the work.

gd_gaslighter.definition: The person who denies the shared account and attacks the person who holds it; the word names the act, not the character.
gd_gaslighter.example: The gaslighter kept the denial flat and turned the talk to her character.

war_reserves.definition: Means held back from the first effort and kept for the moment the situation turns.
war_reserves.example: The plan kept one reserve for the second week.
